column1: # Dual-OTA layout for 4MB flash (same as einkweather).
# nvs keeps its standard offset/size so Wi-Fi credentials and the brightness
# setting survive the switch from the single-app layout. otadata takes the old
# phy_init slot at 0xf000; phy_init shifts to 0x11000.
# The two app slots divide everything from 0x20000 to the end of the 4MB flash
# each is 0x1f0000 -- 64KB more than before. They have to stay equal: a push OTA
# writes the whole image into the inactive one
